lead_headline: Zero restaurant leads for 25th straight day as detection system failure persists through mid-June

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today—detection failure extends to 25 consecutive days as system remains offline through Wednesday, mid-June tracking collapse continues.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today—Wednesday continues this week's freeze following Saturday's 350-application backlog dump, 7-day total unchanged at 369. System processing now dormant four consecutive days (Sun-Wed) after weekend's mass clearance pushed June total beyond normal monthly pace. Prior week's zero applications suggests multi-week dormancy before Saturday's sudden release, leaving current 369-application week as outlier rather than trend. No status changes recorded as system enters mid-month quiet period following early June's two-week shutdown and weekend recovery spike.

reputation.blurb: 9 mentions yesterday—Wednesday rebounds sharply from Mon-Tue's zero-citation drought, lifting 7-day total to 46 mentions across 11 sources, up 24% from prior week's 37. Denver Post drove recovery with 5 citations (56% of Wednesday volume), covering national law firm's Denver IP acquisition, Aurora apartments re-entering receivership, and 16th Street Mall immersive entertainment pitch. Week now tracking +9 vs prior period's comparable Wednesday position, signaling return to spring's stronger baseline after mid-June lull. Reddit added 2 mentions, Instagram and LinkedIn each contributed 1. Monthly pace (206 mentions) suggests June finishing near typical Q2 velocity as late-month pickup offsets early dormancy.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends weekend shutdown to sixth consecutive day, holding MTD net at +13 (+0.8/day) and 90-day net at +130. Wednesday zero follows Sat-Tue dormancy after prior Friday's +3 close ended last 7-day period at +2 net. Current week's six-day freeze (+0 net through Wed) starkly contrasts comparable prior-week position (+7 through Wed), confirming June's persistent acquisition stall. Recent fortnight shows concentrated weekday spikes (June 5's +4, June 9's +3, June 12's +3) followed by multi-day voids—pattern now threatening to drag MTD velocity (+0.8) further below YTD average (+1.2) as mid-month shutdown extends.
